mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT NULL AS stat_id, DATE(wo.actual_start) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS work_order_count, 0 AS completed_count, 0 AS in_progress_count, 0 AS abnormal_count, 0 AS total_plan_qty, 0 AS total_good_qty, 0 AS total_defect_qty, 0 AS avg_oee, 0 AS report_count, NULL AS create_time FROM mms_work_order wo WHERE wo.del_flag = '0' AND wo.actual_start IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(wo.actual_start) ) t WHERE t.stat_id = #{statId}
